fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The card tables on archetype, person, and card detail pages showed only `# Decks` but not how many copies of each card are typically played (a statistic shown by sites like Goldfish and Dreadrise).

## What changed

**`decksite/data/card.py`** — Three preaggregation functions (`preaggregate_card`, `preaggregate_card_archetype`, `preaggregate_card_person`):
- Added `avg_copies FLOAT NOT NULL` column to each CREATE TABLE schema.
- Changed the inner subquery from `(SELECT DISTINCT card, deck_id FROM deck_card)` (which existed to avoid double-counting mainboard+sideboard entries per #5493) to `(SELECT card, deck_id, n FROM deck_card WHERE NOT sideboard)`, which simultaneously eliminates sideboard double-counting and provides the mainboard copy count `n`.
- Added `AVG(dc.n) AS avg_copies` to each SELECT to compute the average number of mainboard copies per deck within each season/deck-type group.

`load_cards` SELECT: added a deck-count-weighted average expression `ROUND(SUM(num_decks * avg_copies) / NULLIF(SUM(num_decks), 0), 2) AS avg_copies` so that the final value correctly weights league vs tournament vs other deck-type groups.

**`shared_web/static/js/cardtable.jsx`** — Added an `Avg` column header (with tooltip "Average number of maindeck copies", sortable by `avgCopies`) and the corresponding `{card.avgCopies}` cell in each data row. The backend camelizes `avg_copies` → `avgCopies` automatically.

## How validated

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all checks passed)
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 848 passed, 1 skipped, 89 deselected (18.54s). No DB-backed integration tests exist for these preaggregation functions; correctness relies on the SQL logic and the unit-test suite passing.

Fixes #10114
